test_tokenize: test the tokenize function to split a sentence into lowercase tokens
test_generate_ngrams: test the generate_ngrams function to produce bigrams from a list of tokens
test_generate_ngrams_range: test the generate_ngrams_range function to produce 1-grams through 3-grams from tokens
test_vocab_from_text: test the VocabFromText class to build a vocabulary from a list of sentences with min_count filtering
test_nucleus_sampling: test nucleus sampling inference using a decoder model with a VocabFromText vocabulary
